note: The GLOBAL level of the presentation cascade — this instance's default rendition for each token family the app can show more than one way. 'wired' is the app's rendition (a checkbox you can click, an <h3>, a rendered sentence); 'raw' is the characters, verbatim. GLOBAL is the LEAST specific of the seven levels, so anything a more specific level says beats it. A key left out of this file stays silent and falls through to the built-in default; a key MISSPELLED here is reported as a problem rather than ignored, because a declaration nobody reads is the bug this level exists to disprove. Served with the app from the site root and read by app/present/declaration.ts. See docs/implementation-artifacts/design-presentation-cascade.md.
